repairs.quote: Jhin's hand cannon has a fixed Attack Speed and can be fired 4 times before needing to be reloaded. The 4th shot always critically strikes, and deals an additional (15% ~ 25%) missing health physical damage. In addition:Jhin gains ((4% ~ 44%) + (35% Critical Strike Chance) + (30% bonus Attack Speed)) bonus Attack DamageJhin's critical strikes deal 25% less damage but grant him (14% + (44% bonus Attack Speed)) Move Speed for 2 seconds.
